description: Hop Bus is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Clémence Inglard. Hop Bus, the 100% free network of the Heart of Flanders.\ \ Find real-time timetables for the Coeur de Flandre agglo bus network and book your Hop bus route on request. An application to travel serenely and easily in the Heart of Flanders. Coverage: Clémence Inglard. The publisher named on the listing is Clémence Inglard. Its keywords include reseaux-de-transport, transport-a-la-demande, reservation, reseau-gratuit, horaires, temps-reel. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP, NC. The listing shows 2025-06-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
